rules: Use pass only when the expected behavior was observed and the evidence was saved.
A test that was not run is not a pass.
Use blocked when firmware or hardware prevents the test; do not infer a pass.
SBAT-01 is unsupported for shipped Aether media. Do not apply an unsigned SBAT update.
Do not include passwords, private keys, TPM secrets or recovery keys.

tests.title: Firmware baseline and Setup Mode
tests.expected: Secure Boot state and key ownership recorded; Setup Mode reached; vendor key restore path documented; test machine remains recoverable.

tests.title: Unsigned EFI binary rejected
tests.expected: Firmware refuses the unsigned BOOTX64.EFI before any Aether code runs; exact message recorded.

tests.title: Installer GUI enrollment
tests.expected: AETHER_SECUREBOOT_ENROLLED; second status reports aether_key_enrolled=true; Aether certificate present in db.

tests.title: Enrollment refused outside Setup Mode
tests.expected: Helper refuses with 'Firmware is not in Setup Mode'; PK, KEK and db are unchanged.
tests.notes: Use a separate machine with an existing PK and Secure Boot disabled. Not part of the minimum overall pass.

tests.title: Signed live ISO boot with Secure Boot on
tests.expected: Live desktop or login reached; secure_boot=true, setup_mode=false, aether_key_enrolled=true, can_enroll=false; no firmware violation.

tests.title: Live media with Aether db absent
tests.expected: With vendor keys and Secure Boot on, Aether live media is rejected unless the vendor db already contains Aether's certificate; record which case applies.
tests.notes: Do this before clearing the vendor keys.

tests.title: Signed install
tests.expected: Installer reports Secure Boot enabled and the Aether signed chain enrolled; erase install completes with no errors.

tests.title: Installed boot and signature verification
tests.expected: aether login: and desktop reached; secure_boot=true and key enrolled; sbverify passes for shim, GRUB and installed UKI.

tests.title: Repeat installed boot
tests.expected: Second reboot reaches the same login prompt and desktop with Secure Boot enabled.

tests.title: Add Aether db certificate to firmware dbx
tests.expected: Firmware accepts the certificate, hash or ESL; both live and installed media are rejected before shim or GRUB; exact messages and firmware log recorded.
tests.notes: Use a photo or transcript for both the live and installed attempts.

tests.title: Unsigned dbx update refused
tests.expected: Firmware refuses the unsigned update and dbx is unchanged.
tests.notes: Record the before and after dbx state. Mark blocked if the firmware cannot perform this test.

tests.title: Signed dbx update (laboratory only)
tests.expected: Disposable test hierarchy accepted; test image signed by the revoked test db is rejected; wrong-key update refused; rotation behaves as described. This is not an Aether production artifact.
tests.notes: Use only a disposable test machine or VM and a disposable test PKI. Never use Aether release private keys.

tests.title: Recovery and re-enrollment
tests.expected: dbx entry removed or keys cleared; Setup Mode reached; Aether public keys enrolled; signed live and installed media boot again.
tests.notes: Record recovery separately from the initial enrollment result.

tests.title: SBAT revocation
tests.expected: Unsupported for shipped Aether media; do not apply an unsigned SBAT update. The disposable OVMF lab fixture covers the mechanism separately.
tests.notes: SBAT-01 is not a pass. Do not mark it pass because the shim boots.
